glade-hello.speaker: narrator
glade-hello.text: This is your Home Glade. Walk to a glowing door to go on an adventure!

door-locked.speaker: narrator
door-locked.text: This door is sleepy. Helping your friends will wake it up!

mirror.speaker: narrator
mirror.text: Press down at the mirror to dress up!

tree.speaker: narrator
tree.text: Press down at the sticker tree to see your stickers!

fetch-done.speaker: narrator
fetch-done.text: You found them all! Go back to your friend!

friend-moved.speaker: narrator
friend-moved.text: Your friend is moving to your Glade!

bunny-ask.speaker: bunny
bunny-ask.text: Oh no! I lost my 3 carrots. Can you find them?

bunny-progress.speaker: bunny
bunny-progress.text: Keep looking! You can do it!

fox-ask.speaker: fox
fox-ask.text: I am so hungry. Can you find 4 berries for me?

owl-hint.speaker: narrator
owl-hint.text: Owl is asleep. Press down to use your horn magic!

owl-thanks.speaker: owl
owl-thanks.text: Hoo! I was asleep all day! Thank you for waking me!

dragon-ask.speaker: dragon
dragon-ask.text: I want to see a rainbow! Can you make the flowers bloom?

dragon-thanks.speaker: dragon
dragon-thanks.text: A rainbow! You are the best friend ever!

power-sniff.speaker: narrator
power-sniff.text: Bunny taught you Sniff! When you see sparkles, press down to sniff out hidden things.

power-dash.speaker: narrator
power-dash.text: Fox taught you Dash! In strong wind, press down to zoom right through it.

power-glow.speaker: narrator
power-glow.text: Owl taught you Glow! Now your horn shines in dark places.

power-warmth.speaker: narrator
power-warmth.text: Dragon taught you Warm Breath! Press down near ice to melt it.

wind-blocked.speaker: narrator
wind-blocked.text: Whoosh! The wind is too strong. A fast friend could teach you to dash.

wind-dash.speaker: narrator
wind-dash.text: Press down to dash through the wind!

ice-blocked.speaker: narrator
ice-blocked.text: Brrr! This ice is too thick. A warm friend could help melt it.

ice-melt.speaker: narrator
ice-melt.text: Press down to melt the ice with your warm breath!

dark-blocked.speaker: narrator
dark-blocked.text: It is too dark to see in here. A friend with big eyes might help.

dark-glow.speaker: narrator
dark-glow.text: Your horn glows! Look around. What is hiding in the dark?

sniff-hint.speaker: narrator
sniff-hint.text: Something sparkly is hidden near here. Press down to sniff!

gate-hint.speaker: narrator
gate-hint.text: A gate with a number lock! Press down to try it.

gate-right.speaker: narrator
gate-right.text: That's right! The gate is opening.

woods-lock.speaker: narrator
woods-lock.text: Bunny planted 2 carrots. Then she planted 3 more. How many carrots in all?

meadow-lock.speaker: narrator
meadow-lock.text: Fox has 4 berries. Fox wants 9 berries. How many more does Fox need?

waterfall-lock.speaker: narrator
waterfall-lock.text: There are 3 nests. Each nest has 2 eggs. How many eggs are there?

clouds-lock.speaker: narrator
clouds-lock.text: There were 12 stars. 5 stars flew away. How many stars are left?

frost-lock.speaker: narrator
frost-lock.text: How many snowmen did you see in Frosty Peaks? Go back and count if you need to!

pattern-start.speaker: narrator
pattern-start.text: Watch the crystals. Then press down at each one in the same order!

gold-star.speaker: narrator
gold-star.text: A golden star! That was tricky!

spark-found.speaker: narrator
spark-found.text: You found a color spark! Bring it home to the Heart Crystal.

new-clue.speaker: narrator
new-clue.text: A new clue! Read it again in your Adventure Book.

item-found.speaker: narrator
item-found.text: You found something special! Who needs it?

meadow-sign.speaker: narrator
meadow-sign.text: Something smells like berries here! Press down to sniff.

waterfall-sign.speaker: narrator
waterfall-sign.text: Strong wind ahead! Fox's dash can zoom right through.

note-1.speaker: pip
note-1.text: Hello. I am very small and very shy. I fell from the sky. From, P.

note-2.speaker: pip
note-2.text: I borrowed the colors of the Heart Crystal to keep warm. I am sorry. From, P.

note-3.speaker: pip
note-3.text: I found a cold, quiet place far away. Snow falls there all day. From, P.

note-4.speaker: pip
note-4.text: Only a warm friend can melt the ice. From, P.

note-5.speaker: pip
note-5.text: Each color spark is one lost color. Please bring them all home. From, P.

note-6.speaker: pip
note-6.text: I can hear the wind blowing near my hiding place. From, P.

note-7.speaker: pip
note-7.text: Look for a door of ice in your Home Glade. That is the way to me. From, P.

note-8.speaker: pip
note-8.text: You are so close now! Look in the dark ice cave. From, P.

pip-found.speaker: pip
pip-found.text: Oh! You found me! I am Pip. I was scared, but you are so kind.

pip-thanks.speaker: pip
pip-thanks.text: Here is the last color spark. Let's fix the Heart Crystal together!

pip-glade.speaker: pip
pip-glade.text: I love my new home! Thank you for finding me.

crystal-0.speaker: narrator
crystal-0.text: The Heart Crystal has lost all its colors. Where did they go?

crystal-1.speaker: narrator
crystal-1.text: The Heart Crystal has 1 color back. 4 more to find!

crystal-2.speaker: narrator
crystal-2.text: The Heart Crystal has 2 colors back. 3 more to find!

crystal-3.speaker: narrator
crystal-3.text: The Heart Crystal has 3 colors back. 2 more to find!

crystal-4.speaker: narrator
crystal-4.text: The Heart Crystal has 4 colors back. Just 1 more!

crystal-need-pip.speaker: narrator
crystal-need-pip.text: All the colors are home! But the crystal feels lonely. Who is still missing?

crystal-finale.speaker: narrator
crystal-finale.text: The Heart Crystal shines with every color! You solved the mystery!

crystal-done.speaker: narrator
crystal-done.text: The Heart Crystal is shining bright, thanks to you!

friend-has-favor.speaker: narrator
friend-has-favor.text: A friend wants to talk. Press down near them!

fox-math-ask.speaker: fox
fox-math-ask.text: I love counting berries! Can you help me with a berry sum?

fox-math-thanks.speaker: fox
fox-math-thanks.text: Yes! 5 berries left. You are so good at numbers!

fox-favor-ask.speaker: fox
fox-favor-ask.text: My den is so dark at night. Owl has a lantern. Can you ask Owl for me?

owl-favor-ask.speaker: owl
owl-favor-ask.text: Hoo! Answer my riddle, and my lantern is yours.

owl-riddle.speaker: owl
owl-riddle.text: I have keys, but I cannot open doors. What am I?

owl-favor-give.speaker: owl
owl-favor-give.text: A piano! Very clever. Here is my lantern. Take it to Fox.

fox-favor-wait.speaker: fox
fox-favor-wait.text: Did you get Owl's lantern yet?

fox-favor-thanks.speaker: fox
fox-favor-thanks.text: My lantern! Now my den is cozy and bright. Thank you!

dragon-favor-ask.speaker: dragon
dragon-favor-ask.text: I want a Moon Shell for my nest. Bunny knows where they hide!

bunny-favor-ask.speaker: bunny
bunny-favor-ask.text: I will tell you where the Moon Shell is. But first, a riddle!

bunny-riddle.speaker: bunny
bunny-riddle.text: I follow you all day, but I hide in the dark. What am I?

bunny-favor-hint.speaker: bunny
bunny-favor-hint.text: A shadow! Moon Shells hide at the Crystal Waterfall. Sniff near the tallest crystal!

dragon-favor-wait.speaker: dragon
dragon-favor-wait.text: Did you find a Moon Shell yet?

dragon-favor-thanks.speaker: dragon
dragon-favor-thanks.text: A Moon Shell! My nest is perfect now. Thank you!

puzzle-wrong-friend.speaker: narrator
puzzle-wrong-friend.text: Hmm, not that one. Think again!

fox-math.speaker: fox
fox-math.text: I had 9 berries. I ate 4. How many berries do I have now?
